title: The Crooked Veil Anew
author: Theo Delacroix
blurb: Silas Okafor, a debt-bound temple scribe, has spent twelve years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the long winter finishes falling.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
